caption: Artistic portrayal of a woman's foot and hand in a round mirror reflection, creating an elegant and minimalist vibe.

A smiling young woman in glasses stands at the right of this vertical street photograph beside an elaborately decorated cycle trishaw that occupies the left two-thirds of the frame. she wears a white t-shirt printed with small blue script, of which the word "mermaid" reads clearly on the second line, black trousers and a dark backpack whose strap she holds with one hand. the trishaw's passenger cab has a white and red painted body with a folded black hood, a deep blue vinyl bench and backrest, a red woven cane panel, and a skirt of pink-and-white diamond-patterned fabric below the seat; silver tinsel garland is looped along the hood edge, a bunch of red and orange artificial roses rests on the seat, and clusters of red pompom flowers and painted poles decorate the front. a large lilac umbrella printed with a small floral repeat is mounted above as a canopy, tilted toward the camera. two big chrome-spoked wheels flank the cab on the wet grey road surface. behind, a pink-washed shophouse wall, shuttered green door, hanging shell ornaments and lush green shrubs fill the background under flat overcast daylight.
